title: May 9 memorial flower-laying observances in Tallinn, Narva and Kohtla-Järve
reason: The opened report describes commemorative flower-laying at memorials, not a public protest making a demand on Estonia’s state/policy. Attendance/simultaneity are also unreported, so the 50-person threshold is not established.
notes: Retain as a potentially conflated lead because Narva locations had monuments removed by government order in 2022; the article nevertheless gives no current state-directed demand or protest action. Do not infer protest from a politically salient memorial site.
